title: Split Message Based on Limit
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: Split message into parts, each ending with an <a/b> suffix, each exactly limit characters except possibly the last. Use as few parts as possible; return an empty array if impossible.
officialConstraints: Secondary summaries: message and limit up to 10^4; message is lowercase letters and spaces (not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps message at 50 characters and limit at 50. Example 'short message' with limit 15 -> ['short mess<1/2>','age<2/2>'] comes from a search summary; not confirmed on the official page.
